explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/604: 'if d(x) counts the number of distinct distances from x then in [Er75f] Erdős conjectured Σ_{x∈A} d(x) ≫ n²/√(log n), where A ⊂ ℝ² is any set of n points.' The Lean statement: ∃ C > 0, for all large n and every n-point A ⊂ ℝ², C·n²/√(log n) ≤ Σ_{x∈A} distinctDistancesFrom A x. Tagged open. Faithful.
